subject: Octopi Tech — vendor onboarding: insurance confirmation & PO setup
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@octopi-tech.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, accounts-payable@octopi-tech.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup paperwork for Redwood Inference

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the warm welcome earlier this week. Attached are the initial files to get Octopi Tech set up as a vendor with Redwood Inference: a one-page coverage summary and our W-9. Can you confirm what additional evidence your team needs to complete vendor activation and issue a PO?

A couple quick items from our side:
- Standard commercial general liability and professional liability coverage in place
- We can add Redwood as additional insured and provide an endorsement if required
- Preferred payment terms: NET30, ACH to the account on the W-9

Attachments: [attachment: Octopi_CoverageSummary.pdf (PDF, 24KB)], [attachment: Octopi_W9.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]

Next steps we need from you: will you attach a PO number for invoicing? Any vendor form we should fill out?

Best,
Maya Singh
VP, Finance & Ops
Octopi Tech
maya.singh@octopi-tech.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@octopi-tech.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup paperwork for Redwood Inference

Maya — thanks for sending these over and for the clear summary. A few items to close out vendor activation and get a PO in place: 

1) Certificate of Insurance (COI) with the following endorsements:
   - Additional Insured: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference
   - Policy limits: General liability at least $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate; Professional liability (E&O) $1M

2) Insurer contact or binder (if COI is pending) so we can record proof of coverage while the endorsement is processed.

3) Remittance details: confirm the bank account on the W-9 is used for ACH payments, and provide an AP contact if it differs from accounts-payable@octopi-tech.com.

Actionable next steps: once the COI with endorsements is received and validated, procurement will issue a conditional PO that Finance can finalize. If you can upload the updated COI to the Drive folder below that will speed verification.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOctopiOnboarding

If you want help routing the request to your broker/legal, we can accept a broker-sent endorsement email as long as it references the certificate.

Thanks — looping in Karthik and Dev to prep the PO path on our side.

— Logan Wright
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@octopi-tech.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@octopi-tech.com
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup paperwork for Redwood Inference

Logan — thanks, understood. I've flagged this with our broker and they are preparing the endorsement; they expect to issue the updated COI by EOD tomorrow.

A couple clarifying questions:
- For the PO, should we include Redwood's tax jurisdiction on our invoices or just line-item the PO number?
- Do you require the broker to add Redwood's primary address exactly as shown on your website (I can provide the exact legal address if needed)?

Attaching the confirmation email from our broker that the endorsement request is in progress.

Attachments: [attachment: Octopi_Certificate_Update.pdf (PDF, 18KB)]

Thanks,
Maya
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@octopi-tech.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 17 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup paperwork for Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick note on the PO process from procurement:

- Once Vendor Ops validates the COI and endorsements, Procurement will create a Purchase Order (PO). That PO will be routed to Finance for issuance and final approval.
- To accelerate on our side, please confirm whether Octopi accepts a conditional PO (we will issue a PO referencing the pending endorsement) and will invoice against the PO once the COI is finalized.
- If Octopi prefers strict gating (no PO until endorsements are on file), we will hold activation but can fast-track review.

Logan / Dev: If acceptable, please prepare a provisional PO number to give Octopi for invoicing in the interim.

On the question about tax jurisdiction — we typically only require the PO number and the vendor tax ID on the invoice. We can handle state tax coding internally.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@octopi-tech.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:41:00 -0700
Subject: Final: PO issued and vendor setup complete — PO A-57821

Maya / Logan — quick confirmation from Finance:

- We received the endorsed COI this afternoon and verified the Additional Insured and Waiver of Subrogation. Coverage limits meet our minimums.
- Vendor record created and PO issued: PO A-57821. Attached is the official PO. Please reference PO A-57821 on all invoices.
- Invoice submission: send invoice PDF to invoices@redwoodinference.com, put PO A-57821 in the subject line, attach remittance instructions if different from the W-9.

Attachments: [attachment: PO_A-57821.pdf (PDF, 6KB)]

Drive (final folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOctopiOnboarding
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/documents/Envelope12345

Thanks — welcome aboard.

Best,
